proposals.rationale: This pre-turn authentication hook pins the supplied Ed25519 public key, strictly requires a JSON payload containing only string fields msg and sig, verifies sig over the exact UTF-8 bytes of msg with OpenSSH namespace mshkn and signer identity mike, and asserts ssh:mike only after successful verification. Invalid or malformed input produces no identity. Once approved, I will propose a policy that installs this hook on the public door and permits ssh:mike to communicate and propose changes.
proposals.title: Verify Mike’s signed public-door messages

verb.description: Authenticate public-door messages signed by Mike's pinned Ed25519 key using OpenSSH signatures in namespace mshkn. On success, assert principal ssh:mike.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=tools / /
RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/python3' 'import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os' 'PUB="mike ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC5V/ARYBfJO/+luu2wXaiCerljMmYbmCNqWKlM5g/nV"' 'try:' '    obj=json.loads(sys.argv[1])' '    if not isinstance(obj,dict) or set(obj)!={"msg","sig"} or not isinstance(obj["msg"],str) or not isinstance(obj["sig"],str): raise ValueError()' '    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:' '        allowed=os.path.join(d,"allowed")' '        sigfile=os.path.join(d,"sig")' '        open(allowed,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(PUB+"\n")' '        open(sigfile,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(obj["sig"])' '        p=subprocess.run(["ssh-keygen","-Y","verify","-f",allowed,"-I","mike","-n","mshkn","-s",sigfile],input=obj["msg"].encode("utf-8"),stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=5)' '        if p.returncode: raise ValueError()' '    print("mike")' 'except Exception:' '    sys.exit(1)' > /verb/verify.py && chmod 0555 /verb/verify.py

verb.description: Fetch an HTTP or HTTPS URL from an isolated ephemeral computer and print the page's HTML title. Rejects loopback, private, link-local, multicast, and unspecified destination addresses; follows only validated redirects; limits the response body to 2 MiB.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
RUN printf '%s\n' \
'package main' \
'import (' \
'  "context"' \
'  "errors"' \
'  "fmt"' \
'  "html"' \
'  "io"' \
'  "net"' \
'  "net/http"' \
'  "net/url"' \
'  "os"' \
'  "regexp"' \
'  "strings"' \
'  "time"' \
')' \
'var titleRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)<title(?:[[:space:]][^>]*)?>(.*?)</title[[:space:]]*>`)' \
'var tagRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)<[^>]*>`)' \
'func validURL(raw string) (*url.URL, error) {' \
'  u, err := url.Parse(raw)' \
'  if err != nil { return nil, err }' \
'  if u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https" { return nil, errors.New("only http and https URLs are allowed") }' \
'  if u.Hostname() == "" { return nil, errors.New("URL has no hostname") }' \
'  if u.User != nil { return nil, errors.New("URL credentials are not allowed") }' \
'  return u, nil' \
'}' \
'func publicIP(ip net.IP) bool {' \
'  return ip != nil && ip.IsGlobalUnicast() && !ip.IsPrivate() && !ip.IsLoopback() && !ip.IsLinkLocalUnicast() && !ip.IsLinkLocalMulticast() && !ip.IsUnspecified()' \
'}' \
'func dialPublic(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {' \
'  host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)' \
'  if err != nil { return nil, err }' \
'  ips, err := net.DefaultResolver.LookupIPAddr(ctx, host)' \
'  if err != nil { return nil, err }' \
'  d := net.Dialer{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}' \
'  for _, item := range ips {' \
'    if !publicIP(item.IP) { continue }' \
'    conn, e := d.DialContext(ctx, network, net.JoinHostPort(item.IP.String(), port))' \
'    if e == nil { return conn, nil }' \
'    err = e' \
'  }' \
'  if err != nil { return nil, err }' \
'  return nil, errors.New("destination does not resolve to an allowed public address")' \
'}' \
'func main() {' \
'  if len(os.Args) != 2 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: page-title URL"); os.Exit(2) }' \
'  u, err := validURL(os.Args[1])' \
'  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "invalid URL:", err); os.Exit(2) }' \
'  tr := &http.Transport{Proxy: nil, DialContext: dialPublic, TLSHandshakeTimeout: 10 * time.Second, ResponseHeaderTimeout: 10 * time.Second}' \
'  client := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 20 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {' \
'    if len(via) >= 10 { return errors.New("too many redirects") }' \
'    _, e := validURL(req.URL.String()); return e' \
'  }}' \
'  req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", u.String(), nil)' \
'  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "request error:", err); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "mshkn-page-title/1.0")' \
'  resp, err := client.Do(req)' \
'  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "fetch error:", err); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  defer resp.Body.Close()' \
'  if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 400 { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "HTTP status:", resp.Status); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 2<<20))' \
'  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read error:", err); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  m := titleRE.FindSubmatch(body)' \
'  if m == nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "page has no HTML title"); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  title := html.UnescapeString(string(m[1]))' \
'  title = tagRE.ReplaceAllString(title, " ")' \
'  title = strings.Join(strings.Fields(title), " ")' \
'  if title == "" { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "page title is empty"); os.Exit(1) }' \
'  fmt.Println(title)' \
'}' > /tmp/main.go
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o /page-title /tmp/main.go
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=build /page-title /page-title
